purpose: Teach: 住友/トルシエ/ディープインパクト/ホリデー/シューティング/師範/ラヴ/ボクサー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、住友銀行にお勤めだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So the customer works at Sumitomo Bank, doesn't she?
lines.style: Quiet, wondering tone. A small discovery shared between friends. Gentle curiosity, almost marveling at how much one person can contain.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、トルシエ監督時代のサッカー日本代表ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer was a fan of Troussier's Japan team, wasn't she?
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment, turning the thought over. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Finding something endearing in the detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ディープインパクトの競走ファンだったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She used to be a fan of Deep Impact, the racehorse.
lines.style: Reflective exhale. Speaking more to herself than to Mei. The gentleness of noticing someone's specific loves.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海外ホリデーで日焼けされたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer came back from overseas holiday with a tan, didn't she?
lines.style: Light observation, almost a small smile in the voice. Noticing the physical evidence of someone's life outside the café.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シューティングゲームの大会に出るって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's competing in a shooting game tournament, apparently.
lines.style: Genuine surprise softly delivered. The pleasure of discovering an unexpected layer to someone. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、剣道師範を務められてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer holds the rank of kendo instructor, she said.
lines.style: Respect settling in quietly. A certain formality creeping in—the awareness of someone's discipline and skill. Spoken with understated admiration.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、洋楽のラヴソング集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She collects Western love songs, doesn't she?
lines.style: Something tender in this one. The vulnerability of knowing what someone listens to alone. Soft, almost protective in the tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、元プロボクサーでいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer used to be a professional boxer.
lines.style: Final piece falling into place. Wonder in a lower register. Speaking almost reverently. The kind of quiet that closes a conversation gently.
